plan.question: once a head-and-shoulders right shoulder is in play, does the pattern say when the neckline breaks and when the measured move completes, better than the base rates?

detector.input: weekly closes (W-SUN last, complete weeks only); dominance shares in logit space (share/100), prices in log space; ETHUSD = ETHBTC x BTCUSD on common dates
detector.lowShareCaveat: logit space turns small moves at low shares into large reversals (from 0.3% to 0.4% share is 0.29 in logit, more than r=0.15): 3 of the 63 pooled patterns have the head below 1% share (USDT.D r=0.08 S2 2017-05-28, USDT.D r=0.08 S2 2019-01-06, USDT.D r=0.15 S2 2017-05-28); laws.*.robustness.excludingLowShareHeads repeats the test without them. BTC.D's TradingView history before the splice week has a weekly logit-change std of 0.168 against 0.051 after it (early coverage of few coins); the splice rule keeps those weeks out of the real pool, while the pre-registered BTC.D placebos are built from the whole series (laws.*.robustness.btcdPlacebosFromPostSpliceSegment re-runs the test with post-splice BTC.D surrogates)
detector.zigzag: a peak (trough) is a pivot only once a weekly close r below (above) it has printed; the pivot's confirmation week is recorded
detector.pattern: five consecutive pivots S1 T1 H T2 S2 (top: peak trough peak trough peak; inverse: the mirror on the negated series)

geometry.neckline: the line through T1 and T2; |rise over S1..S2| <= 0.5 x head height (H - neckline at H)
geometry.shoulderSpan: H -> S2 between 1/3 and 3 x S1 -> H
geometry.shouldersAboveNeckline: S1 and S2 above the neckline at their own weeks (a well-formed, unbroken pattern)

detector.inPlayWeekRule: the week S2 is confirmed (the first close r away from S2); detection uses nothing after it

outcomes.break: first weekly close beyond the neckline after S2 (may fall before the in-play week: brokenAtConfirmation)
outcomes.target: neckline at the break -/+ head height
outcomes.completion: first close beyond the target, looked for within 78 weeks of the break
outcomes.failed: a close beyond S2 before the break
outcomes.expired: no break within 78 weeks of S2
outcomes.in-play: none of the above yet at the data end

detector.baseline: expanding median of the law's actual duration over pool patterns whose outcome was known before the prediction date (same threshold, all series; needs 3 prior patterns)

placebos.iaaft: IAAFT surrogate of the transformed weekly series (50 iterations)
placebos.rw: matched random walk: the series' own increments resampled in 13-week blocks with random signs
placebos.poolRule: the same BTC-dominance splice rule as the real patterns
placebos.history: surrogates are built from each series' full weekly history (its amplitude distribution and power spectrum, or its increments), not point in time: that is the intended null, and it enters no real-pattern quantity because the detector then runs point in time on each surrogate

timeScale.note: IAAFT surrogates keep the exact marginal (share series stay inside 0..100) but are choppier than the real series; the matched random walk is not level-matched (its levels drift outside the real range), harmless for the translation-invariant logit/log detector. Placebo patterns are shorter than real ones at the same threshold, which is why laws.*.scaleDiagnostics holds the time scale fixed.

placebos.postSpliceBTCD: diagnostic only: BTC.D surrogates built from the post-splice segment (the regime of the pooled real BTC.D patterns), used in laws.*.robustness.btcdPlacebosFromPostSpliceSegment; the pre-registered family is unchanged

detector.pool: all series; BTC.D patterns with S2 before 2018-06-03 and BTCD_CMC patterns with S2 from 2018-06-03 on are left out so one BTC-dominance history is counted
detector.nearestStructure: when no pattern is in play: the five-pivot window of the expected kind with S2 in the last 130 weeks (the provisional extreme allowed as S2) that fails the fewest checks

pointInTimeCheck.rule: patterns confirmed by the cut and outcomes known by the cut are identical on the truncated and the full series

detector.rankTest: one-sided Mann-Whitney (normal approximation, tie and continuity corrected), real |error| < placebo |error|

definition.breakWithinWeeksOfInPlay: share of patterns in play at confirmation whose first close beyond the neckline came within H weeks of the in-play week
definition.targetWithinWeeksOfBreak: share of breaks whose first close beyond the measured-move target came within H weeks of the break
definition.headHeightMoveWithinWeeksOfInPlay: share of in-play patterns where the series moved one head height in the pattern's direction within H weeks of the in-play week
definition.matchedBaseRateSameSeriesEra: the same move-by-head-height chance from every week of the same series and era, averaged over the same patterns; an IN-SAMPLE era rate (the era's weeks include weeks after the in-play week and the pattern's own weeks), descriptive, not a point-in-time base rate: matchedEqualMove carries the variants without the pattern's own weeks and the expanding (point-in-time) one
definition.breakWithinWeeksOfInPlayCaveat: the sloped-neckline break, censored by fails (a close beyond S2 ends the pattern): it is neither an equal-move base-rate comparison nor comparable with the raw placebo rate (placebo patterns are shorter); see matchedEqualMove and spanMatchedPlacebo

definition.fixedLevelNecklineBreakWithinWeeksOfInPl: in-play patterns: a weekly close beyond the neckline LEVEL fixed at the in-play week within H weeks (not censored by fails); move = in-play close minus that level
definition.targetWithinWeeksOfBreak: breaks: the pre-registered first close beyond the target within H weeks of the break; move = break close minus target
definition.headHeightMoveWithinWeeksOfInPlay: in-play patterns: a move of one head height from the in-play close within H weeks
definition.eraInSample: base rate over every week of the same series and era (includes later weeks and the pattern's own weeks)
definition.eraExcludingOwnWeeks: the same without the pattern's own weeks S1 .. anchor + H (the plan's 'without a pattern')
definition.expandingPointInTime: weeks of the same series whose H-week window had closed by the anchor week (in-play week, or the break week for the target)
